### Fixes
- Media notes whose media is a web address now embed as that photo or video. A note with `url: "https://example.com/photo.jpg"` used to fall back to an ordinary note embed, with its title and border; only notes linking to a file in the vault became media embeds. Both now give Obsidian's own image or video embed, with its resize handle and zoom and edit buttons while editing.

### Validation
- 54 automated tests pass, plus lint and the production build.
- Checked in Obsidian 1.15.1 desktop with a photo served over HTTP: the embed shows as a plain image in reading view and in the editor, with Obsidian's image controls in the editor. Embeds of vault media and of ordinary notes are unchanged. Mobile was not tested on a device.
